text: What if you don’t feel like a Nurturer? What if nothing comes to mind when you think about your child, your sweet little angel? Then start a relationship as a Protector. It may not seem as warm and fuzzy, but it’s a start. And warmth can be added later. What can you, as Protector, do for your child? It’s easy! Make sure there is a locked door for your toddler to sleep behind each night. Put a healthy meal on the table every night (even if it’s McDonald’s a couple times a week). Cancel your Saturday plans to stay home with your child (it’s OK if you don’t want to do it, just do it anyway).
